retained_failures: The first compiled five-header audit stopped before value streams: independently elaborated witnesses named their singleton universe differently. Matching only the binder of each witness to its measured declaration universe reproduced all five full canonical types in both directions.

An earlier terminal-existence proof used a zero affine support in the growth argument. The accepted private proof applies minimum growth directly to the lifted last actual hinted objective.
